qa.q: In the first benchmark, which approach did the agent conclude was better for downscaling images, and what were the key numbers for the 48 MP JPEG case?
qa.a: ImageIO thumbnail (CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex) beat decode + Accelerate/vImage Lanczos scale. For the 48 MP JPEG it took about 170 ms and 56 MiB peak footprint, against about 740 ms and 388 MiB for vImage. vImage only tied on PNG, where it used about 3x the memory.

qa.q: What change did the agent make to the encode order in ImageReader.swift, and why?
qa.a: PNG encoding of a photo costs about 260-350 ms and gives 3-5 MB, while JPEG costs 10-30 ms and gives 0.4-0.7 MB. Photos now try JPEG first. PNG still goes first when the source is image/png or image/gif or has an alpha channel (the `favoursPNG` check). The pi limits were kept: 2000 px, 4.5 MiB as base64, the same JPEG qualities, and shrinking by a quarter.

qa.q: How does the byte-offset-to-position table in the new MarkdownSourceLines.swift count positions, and why?
qa.a: It splits lines at line feeds and counts a tab as four graphemes, matching TranscriptContent.hardLines(of:) on the copy side (which replaces \t with 4 spaces), so selection offsets for rendered Markdown agree with the copied text.

qa.q: What design decision was made for PartRepository stock handling, and what error is thrown?
qa.a: Because the product currently only supports taking out/returning from one location at a time, the multi-entry StockAdjustmentPlan was dropped. PartRepository.takeOut and returnStock work only on the 'No Location' stock entry (found by paging through entries, page size 100) and send a single PATCH. If the entry is absent, StockAdjustmentError.missingNoLocationEntry is thrown.

qa.q: Why did the `AuthorizationSessionUnitTest` run crash the test host, and what was the fix?

The fix was to mark that test `@MainActor`. All 18 tests then passed.
